_comment: This repo (the dev-tools plugin) ships C# test fixtures under test/ai-plan-adapters/fixtures/ that trip auto stack-profile detection (it would map the fixtures as dotnet modules). It also has no package.json workspaces or src/ tree, so glob/auto discovery can't find the real code. Define the product modules explicitly.

manual.name: ai-plan
manual.description: Code/module-graph generator: module discovery, enrichment, rendering, doctor, and bootstrap.

manual.name: code-map
manual.description: ast-grep-based symbol and endpoint indexer that feeds the module graph.

manual.name: lib
manual.description: Shared utilities for both generators: plugin-root resolution, ast-grep resolution, skip-dirs, scan parsing.
